2 · The difference

Şengün: 19 points, 13 rebounds, 9 assists

8 of 14 from the floor, one assist shy of a triple-double.

3 · How it turned

Up 15 after one, then pulled away in the fourth

Durant and Şengün combined for 39 of 115.

4 · Where it was won

Won it in the paint and on the break

Points in the paint 50–34; fast-break points 19–7. Houston made 6 of 10 threes in the fourth.

5 · Final

Rockets 115, Warriors 108.

From the Warriors’ side: Lost the first quarter 20–35, then won the rest of the game 88–80.

What it meant: the Rockets are 9–3, 4th in the West, with 82% top-6 odds now. The Warriors are 8–4, 6th in the West, at 26%.

2 · The play of the game

Sheppard again.

Reed Sheppard's 3-pointer with 8:43 left in the fourth quarter, his second in a row, that made it 96–85.
